Danapak Flexibles A/S.event: Renamed to adapa flexibles Denmark Slagelse A/S as part of the adapa Group rebranding
Danapak Flexibles A/S.evidence: According to the company's official website, the entity formerly known as Danapak Flexibles A/S operates as the Pharma Centre of Excellence under the name adapa flexibles Denmark Slagelse A/S, supplying high-quality laminates and films for the pharmaceutical and medical device industries.
